needs.what: a player-scoped attack requirement lasting through the target opponent's next turn: every creature that player controls during that turn (including ones that arrive later) must attack a specific defender, the source planeswalker, if able
needs.why_existing_wont_do: must_attack sets a flag only on creatures already on the battlefield at resolution, takes durations this_turn/next_combat only, and names no defender -- it cannot require attacking Gideon rather than the player, and it misses creatures that enter during that turn. The attacks_if_able static likewise has no defender and no 'target opponent's next turn' duration; cant_attack_player is a prohibition, not a requirement

needs.what: prevent all damage that would be dealt to a specific permanent (here the source itself) this turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage takes only duration and player -- it prevents damage to a player, not to an object; there is no objects/self_only option for a permanent
